_note: Copy this file to seek.config.json and edit it. seek.config.json is gitignored,
so your watchlist and credentials-adjacent settings stay out of version control.
If seek.config.json is missing or malformed, every source defaults to DISABLED
(helper/seek/config.ts defaultConfig) — the sweep does nothing rather than
guessing. That is intentional: nothing here runs until you turn it on.
SOURCES THAT NEED NO ACCOUNT (public, documented endpoints):
greenhouse / lever / ashby - public board APIs, meant to be consumed.
hn                         - Hacker News 'who is hiring' threads.
simplify                   - the public SimplifyJobs/New-Grad-Positions
listings.json on GitHub. Not a scrape of
simplify.jobs. Credit to SimplifyJobs; the feed
is ~12 MB, so please do not poll it aggressively.
ycdir                      - api.ycombinator.com public companies endpoint.
Yields board slugs only, never postings.
getro                      - public VC-portfolio board JSON.
SOURCES THAT REQUIRE YOUR OWN LOGGED-IN ACCOUNT — off by default:
yc        - Work at a Startup.
jobright  - jobright.ai personalised recommendations.
These drive a real browser session through scripts/seek-sidecar.mjs using
YOUR account, stored in .runner-profile/ (gitignored — no credentials ship
with this repo). Automated access to a logged-in area may conflict with
those sites' terms of service. Enabling them is your call and your
responsibility. They fetch listing metadata only (company, title, link) —
never job descriptions, which are read from the employer's own page — and
referral parameters such as ?utm_source=&jr_id= are preserved on click
through so the originating site keeps its attribution.
batch.enabled is false here on purpose: it fills real employer application
forms unattended. Read scripts/batch-runner.mjs and set hostAllowlist before
you ever turn it on.
